claim_one_line: THE TOWERS IN F-THEORY'S 7-BRANE FRAME (P-415, the owner's towers question; data-free; NEGATIVE for the towers-meeting-at-loci reading): the genesis word LR (trace 3) lies in the single SL(2,Z) class DeWolfe-Hauer-Iqbal-Zwiebach assign to E_10 = E_8^H (a conjugator computed), whose nested subconfigurations A^(N-1)BCC carry su(3)+su(2), su(5), so(10), E6, E7, E8, affine E8; but only so(10)-E8 can collapse to singularities -- su(3)+su(2) (trace -4) and su(5) (trace -3) are hyperbolic and non-collapsible, their algebras organising massive BPS states, not gauge symmetries at a point; the object fixes the total class, not where any tower sits. m003's sign class is E_4's. Among the metallic words only the golden one is an E-series monodromy (content). Complements B1343. None of the 19. [Scope corrected 2026-10-30 at Review 73: 'cannot collapse' holds for the nested E_3 and E_4 realisations only; inside the same configuration A^5 < A^5BC < A^5BCC collapse (I_5 < I_1* < IV*), so SU(5) < SO(10) < E6 can meet at a point and the SM's algebra can sit at points as A-brane stacks -- allowed by the object's class, not selected by it.]
